description: Historical investment return using installed monthly closes, not live quotes. Asset ticker, start/end months YYYY-MM, amount in USD (unit=cash) or historical shares/coins (unit=coins), buying fee in percent, optional benchmark and total/price return basis. Omitted dates use calculator defaults clamped to asset/benchmark coverage. Returns data coverage/source metadata and the free calc-return PNG. Returns results, conditions, assumptions, an editable link, share page and PNG. No account access or order execution.

amount.description: Dollar budget including fees, or coin/share quantity when unit is coins.

asset.description: Asset ticker. Available historical start dates vary by asset.

buyFee.description: Buying fee as a percentage, e.g. 0.1 means 0.1%.

end.description: End month, YYYY-MM. Must be within the installed data snapshot.

include_image.description: Also inline a PNG no wider than 1000 pixels. Image URL is always returned.

returnBasis.description: total reinvests distributions; price excludes distributions.

unit.description: cash for a dollar budget; coins for a coin or share quantity.
